narrator: Dr. Seward (diary), Mina Harker (letters), Dr. Patrick Hennessey (report)
summary: Seward and Van Helsing arrive at Hillingham to find the house locked; they saw through the iron bars of a kitchen window, find the four maids drugged and Lucy and her dead mother in bed, Lucy barely alive. They revive her in a hot bath, and Quincey Morris, arriving by chance on Arthur's telegram, supplies blood for a fourth transfusion. A paper from Lucy's breast puzzles Seward, and Van Helsing keeps it. Seward registers Mrs. Westenra's death from heart disease. Quincey tells of a vampire bat that killed his mare on the Pampas. On 19 September Lucy fades; Arthur arrives at sunset. Mina's unopened letters describe Hawkins's bequest and death; Hennessey's report tells of Renfield attacking the carriers who delivered great wooden boxes to the empty house (Carfax), crying that he will fight for his Lord and Master. On the night of 20 September Lucy's wounds vanish, her teeth look longer, she tears at the garlic while asleep and clutches it while awake. She dies; just before, in a voluptuous voice she asks Arthur to kiss her, and Van Helsing hurls him back. Her last words commend Arthur to Van Helsing. Van Helsing says: 'It is only the beginning!'

scenes.title: The locked house
scenes.summary: Seward rings and knocks without answer; windows and doors are locked. Van Helsing arrives by swift horse and fears they are too late.
scenes.key_quote: If there be no way open to get in, we must make one.

scenes.title: Cutting through the kitchen window
scenes.summary: Van Helsing hands Seward a small surgical saw; Seward cuts three iron bars. A long thin knife pushes back the sash fastening. They enter and find the four drugged maids.
scenes.key_quote: The Professor took a small surgical saw from his case

scenes.title: Two women on the bed
scenes.summary: Mrs. Westenra lies dead under a white sheet; the garlic is on her bosom and Lucy's throat is bare with two white mangled wounds. Van Helsing hears a heartbeat and calls for brandy.
scenes.key_quote: It is not yet too late! Quick! quick! Bring the brandy!

scenes.title: The hot bath
scenes.summary: Seward wakes three maids with a wet towel; they heat water. Lucy is warmed in a bath, her heart beats audibly; Van Helsing ties a silk handkerchief round her throat. A messenger from Holmwood is left waiting at the door.
scenes.key_quote: The first gain is ours! Check to the King!

scenes.title: Quincey Morris arrives; fourth transfusion
scenes.location: Hillingham dining-room and Lucy's new room
scenes.summary: Quincey is on the dining-room sofa with Arthur's telegram. He offers blood and Van Helsing performs the fourth transfusion with a subcutaneous morphia injection.
scenes.key_quote: A brave man's blood is the best thing on this earth when a woman is in trouble.

scenes.title: The paper from Lucy's breast
scenes.summary: Van Helsing reads Lucy's memorandum, replaces it in her breast, and in sleep Lucy tears it and scatters imaginary pieces.
scenes.key_quote: It dropped from Lucy's breast when we carried her to the bath.

scenes.title: Death certificate and Quincey's questions
scenes.summary: Seward arranges registration and undertaker. Quincey deduces four men's blood has gone into Lucy and recalls his mare killed by a vampire bat on the Pampas.
scenes.key_quote: One of those big bats that they call vampires had got at her in the night

scenes.title: Mina's letters and Hennessey's report
scenes.summary: Hawkins leaves everything to the Harkers and then dies. Renfield, enraged by the carriers delivering great boxes to the empty house, escapes through his window and attacks them.
scenes.key_quote: I'll fight for my Lord and Master!

scenes.title: Arthur at Lucy's bedside
scenes.summary: Arthur arrives at sunset and speaks with Lucy; they take turns watching.
scenes.key_quote: I fear that to-morrow will end our watching

scenes.title: The bat and the garlic
scenes.summary: A great bat strikes the window in full moonlight; Lucy tears the garlic off asleep and clutches it awake. Her canines look longer.
scenes.key_quote: whenever she got into that lethargic state ... she put the flowers from her; but that when she waked she clutched them close

scenes.title: Death of Lucy
scenes.summary: Lucy's wounds vanish; she wakes asking Arthur for a kiss in a voluptuous voice, Van Helsing hurls him back; she then asks Van Helsing to guard Arthur and dies.

vampire_lore.rule: Blood drained faster than it can be replaced
vampire_lore.detail: Four men's blood put into Lucy within ten days, none remains.
vampire_lore.quote: the blood of four strong men. Man alive, her whole body wouldn't hold it.

vampire_lore.rule: Wounds vanish at the point of vampiric change
vampire_lore.quote: The wounds on the throat had absolutely disappeared.

vampire_lore.detail: Canines look longer and sharper in the vampire state.
vampire_lore.quote: the pale gums, drawn back, made the teeth look longer and sharper than ever

vampire_lore.rule: Dual state: sleep-vampire vs. waking self
vampire_lore.detail: Asleep she repels garlic and speaks voluptuously; awake she is herself and clutches it.
vampire_lore.quote: she put the flowers from her; but that when she waked she clutched them close

vampire_lore.rule: Kiss from the victim is dangerous
vampire_lore.detail: Lucy's seductive plea to Arthur; Van Helsing hurls him back.
vampire_lore.quote: Not for your life! not for your living soul and hers!

vampire_lore.detail: The attack is helped by drugged servants and an opened window; bars and locks protect but wolf breaks glass.
vampire_lore.quote: Every window and door was fastened and locked

vampire_lore.rule: Vampire servant madman senses master and boxes
vampire_lore.detail: Renfield reacts violently to the cart carrying boxes; 'my Lord and Master'.
vampire_lore.quote: I'll fight for my Lord and Master!

vampire_lore.detail: The bat returns on full-moon nights.
Van Helsing: Lucy's death is only the beginning.
vampire_lore.quote: Not so; alas! not so. It is only the beginning!

puzzles.name: Break into the locked house
puzzles.setup: All doors and windows locked, servants unresponsive.
puzzles.book_solution: Saw through bars at the kitchen window, then slide a thin knife in to lift the sash catch.
puzzles.game_idea: Lockpicking/entry puzzle: pick the weakest point of the house and use the right tool.
puzzles.quote: I attacked them at once and had very soon cut through three of them.

puzzles.name: Revive the frozen victim
puzzles.obstacle: Restore body heat before a transfusion.
puzzles.book_solution: Brandy rubs, wake maids, heat water, warm bath, hot sheet, brandy drops.
puzzles.game_idea: Sequenced task: gather resources in the right order within turns while the patient's vitality ticks down.
puzzles.quote: She will need be heated before we can do anything more.

puzzles.name: Test for tampering
puzzles.book_solution: Smell and taste brandy before use.
puzzles.quote: taking care to smell and taste it, lest it, too, were drugged

puzzles.name: The vanishing wounds
puzzles.book_solution: Van Helsing lifts the handkerchief in light and sees them gone.
puzzles.game_idea: Inspection mini-game: compare wound states between nights to deduce the stage.
puzzles.quote: The wounds on the throat had absolutely disappeared.

puzzles.name: Deduce the blood count
puzzles.setup: Quincey asks what took the blood.
puzzles.book_solution: Quincey totals the donors and recalls the vampire bat.
puzzles.game_idea: Deduction board linking donors, nights and symptoms.

combat.name: Renfield vs the carriers and attendants
combat.tactics: Renfield drags a carrier by the neck and batters his head; ignores a blow to the head; throws three men about; subdued when the waistcoat goes on.
combat.outcome: Hardy's finger broken; Renfield returned to the padded room.
combat.game_idea: Boss-like encounter with a damage-resistant enemy; player must apply a restraint item over several turns to end it.
combat.quote: struggled with the three of us, pulling us to and fro as if we were kittens

combat.name: Van Helsing blocks Arthur
combat.tactics: Hurl Arthur away from the kiss.
combat.outcome: Arthur saved; Lucy's rage flickers and she relaxes.
combat.game_idea: Scripted choice scene: protect an ally from a lethal temptation by acting first.
combat.quote: he stood between them like a lion at bay
